description: Defines the QuicHttpStream class, a QUIC-specific implementation of an HTTP stream that manages sending and receiving data over a QUIC connection, including stream state management, request handling, and error processing.

classes.name: QuicHttpStream
classes.description: A QUIC-specific HTTP stream class that manages data transmission over a QUIC connection, including request/response handling, stream state, and error management.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request information with the stream.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream with parameters such as early sending capability, priority, and logging.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with headers and prepares to receive a response.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads the response headers from the stream.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body data.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, optionally marking it as not reusable.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully received.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates whether the connection was reused.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Gets alternative service info.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the request priority.

methods.name: SetRequestIdempotency
methods.description: Sets the idempotency of the request.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Returns DNS aliases associated with the stream.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Returns ALPS accept-ch information.

methods.name: GetQuicErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the QUIC error code if any.

methods.name: GetQuicRstStreamErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the QUIC RST stream error code if any.

methods.name: ConnectionInfoFromQuicVersion
methods.description: Static method to get connection info from a QUIC version.
